'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**A [[Precision Air]] airliner with 43 persons aboard crashes into [[Lake Victoria]], [[Tanzania]]. Nineteen occupants are killed; the others are rescued. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/6/tanzanias-precision-air-plane-crashes-into-lake-victoria (Al Jazeera)]
